tools.name: find_business
tools.description: Find a business that answers support questions through Alvrun, and get the identifier you need to ask one. Search by website domain for an exact match, or by name to see the candidates. Names repeat across companies, so when several come back, choose using the domain rather than the name.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a business's customer support a question and get their official answer, taken from that business's own verified support knowledge.
